FEVER. [40] [Ham.]
Chilly on going to bed ; dreaded an attack of fever.
Chilliness over back and hips, extending down extremities.
Whole body dry and hot, at night.
Fever at night ; hands hot, burning in eyelids on closing them.
Sweats freely at night, after lying down.
Pulse accelerated ; fever.
Pulse 60 to 70 and full.
Typho-malarial fever ; seventeenth day bloody stools, on twentieth day, profuse stool, consisting almost entirely of black, partly coagulated, offensive blood ; six profuse hemorrhages occurred on this day and night ; temperature fell ; respiration hurried ; surface circulation poor ; skin cool, pulse weak, 140 ; anxious look on face ; bruised sore feeling in abdomen and hips.
Hemorrhagic variola ; blood dark, venous ; oozing of dark blood from nose ; bleeding gums, hematemesis, bloody stools ; uterine hemorrhage, petechiæ ; tearing pains across small of back, with fulness of joints of legs ; typhoid condition.
Uterine hemorrhages, with or without abortion, in yellow fever.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Ham.]
At irregular intervals : epistaxis of from six to twenty-four hours.
Every fifteen minutes : discharge of pure blood.
Two hours after a hearty meal : cramps in stomach.
Every three or four hours : thin, dark, rose-colored, offensive stools.
For hours : severe pain in head of right humerus.
Every day : from 10 to 15 stools ; ovarian region becomes swollen.
For days : soreness in head of humerus, extending down arms to elbow-joint.
In three days : swelling spread from thigh to whole left leg.
Seventeenth day : typhoid malarial fever ; bloody stools.
Twentieth day : profuse stools : six profuse hemorrhages occurred.
Two weeks after confinement : feverish, thirsty, sleepless.
Every month for twenty years : hemorrhage from lungs.
For months or years : hemorrhoids with hemorrhage with every evacuation.
For three months : drawing pain in left spermatic cord.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Ham.]
Right : deafness in ear ; bleeding at ear ; burning in cheek ; shooting along superior maxillary to malar bone ; sore throat right side ; tonsil more swollen ; enlargement of testicle ; paroxysm of pain in groin ; pain commences in region of ovary ; swelling in groin ; pain in groin ; severe pain in head Of humerus ; tenderness of right biceps ; dull pains in elbow-joint ; violent pain in back of hand to shoulder-joint ; sore pain in femur and muscles of thigh ; great pain and swelling in leg from knee to hip.
Left : hammering over eye ; after injury to eye abrasion of cornea ; bleeding of nose commenced in side of nose ; sharp pains in hypochondrium ; enlargement of spermatic vein ; drawing pain in spermatic cord ; testicle painful ; paroxysms of pain in ovary ; ovaritis ; stiffness and weakness of leg ; swelling of labium, groin and thigh, then of whole leg ; pain in hip ; granulations and redness of vocal cord ; dull aching pain in muscles of chest ; rheumatic pains in arm ; lancinating in wrist-joint.
From within outwards : blood venous, raised with little effort, like a simple warm current.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Ham.]
Prickling stinging : veins, muscles, skin.
Bruised, soreness.
Felt as if he were going out of his mind ; as if a bolt were passing from temple to temple and tightly screwed ; as if head would burst ; as if both eyes would be forced out of head ; tongue feels as if burnt ; as if uvula would break when he coughs ; feeling as if something had lodged in fauces ; as if piles would protrude ; back as if it would break ; anus as if raw ; as if he had not slept ; tongue as though dead ; veins of feet appeared as though blood was dried up ; the muscles of thighs sore as if bruised ; legs feel full as if they would burst.
Pains : in teeth in warm room ; on swallowing ; in testicles ; back of stomach ; running down spermatic cords into testes ; in left testicle ; dart from testicles to stomach ; in r. groin ; in epigastrium ; in lumbar region ; in left ovarian region ; in hemorrhoids ; in left hip ; in right groin ; in kidneys.
Excruciating pain : in eyes ; in testicles.
Violent pain : in back of right hand to shoulder-joint : at bladder.
Severe pain : in head ; in lumbar and hypogastric region ; in head of humerus.
Great pains : in anus ; in right leg.
Sharp lancinating : along molar teeth extending to malar bone ; in temporal region ; in left wrist-joint.
Bursting headache.
Cutting, tearing pains : in ovary.
Tearing pains : across small of back.
Shooting pains : along right maxillary to malar bone.
Sharp pains : in temple ; in stomach ; in left hypochondrium.
Severe pleuritic stitches : with phthisis.
Stitching : in lower part of lungs.
Severe stinging : in uvula.
Severe neuralgic pain : in testicles ; of ovaries.
Burning pain : in back.
Pricking pain : in region of heart and veins of arms.
Prickling pain : from wrist to shoulder.
Violent colicky pains.
Cramp pains : in stomach and chest ; around umbilicus ; of lower limbs.
Cramp : in stomach ; in transverse colon.
Intense aching : in thighs.
Bearing down pain : in back ; in ovaries.
Severe drawing pains : in flexor muscles, wrists, hands and fingers.
Drawing pains : about umbilicus ; in left spermatic cord ; in testicles.
Rheumatic pain : in left arm.
Agonizing soreness : over whole abdomen.
Burning : in eyes ; in right cheek ; in stomach ; in œsophagus ; in epigastrium ; in umbilicus ; at orifice of anus ; of piles ; of eyelids.
Sore pain : in eyes ; in gums ; down cervical vertebræ ; in r. femur and muscles of thighs.
Soreness : of abdomen ; of anus ; of nipples ; in head of humerus ; of thumb-nail ; in femoral vessels ; of affected parts ; of skin.
Scalding sensation : on tongue.
Bruised feeling : in upper arms and shoulders ; in abdomen and hips.
Aching : in head ; in groin.
Violent throbbing : in stomach.
Distressing throbbing : in head.
Dull throbbing pains : in back and top of head.
Dull, heavy, drawing pains : in feet and toes.
Dull, dragging pain : in lumbar region ; in legs.
Dull frontal headache.
Heavy frontal headache.
Dull pain : in hypochondriac region ; in renal region ; in lumbar region ; in testicles ; in sacrum ; in hips ; in right elbow-joint.
Dull aching pain : in muscles of left chest.
Painful fulness : of joints ; of legs.
Painful weakness : of eyes.
Constant pains : in abdomen.
Painful sensation of heaviness : in lower abdomen.
Painful but benumbed sensation of limb.
Weak pain : in back.
Sore, stiff feeling : in muscles.
Stiffness : in arms and shoulders ; of hands and fingers.
Crowding fulness : in head, in neck, in forehead.
Fulness : in head ; in hypochondriac region ; of vagina ; in neck ; of joints of legs.
Forcing feeling : in varices.
Stopped up feeling : in nose.
Tightness : across bridge of nose ; across lower part of thorax ; of chest.
Dulness : in head.
Tired feeling : in arms and legs.
Hammering : over left eye.
Pulsation : in rectum.
Trembling : in stomach.
Benumbed sensation : over whole os frontis.
Tickling : in larynx.
Itching : at anus ; of vulva.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Ham.]
Venous congestions ; hemorrhages.
Passive congestion, or venous stagnation of skin and mucous membranes.
Venous congestion, hemorrhoids, conjunctival vascularity, ciliary neuralgia, photophobia, lachrymation.
Hemorrhages from all mucous membranes.
Hemorrhages with asthenia or anemia.
Profuse discharges, which simulate a hemorrhage, and constitute a drain upon system as severe as a loss of blood.
Evil effects from loss of blood.
Phlegmasia alba dolens.
Hemorrhagic purpura.
Phlebitis ; prickling pains.
Varices, knotted appearance, extreme thinness of skin, blueness, almost blackness of pouches, parts feel soft and fluctuating.
Varicose veins and ulcers with stinging or pricking.
Varicose ulcers deep, circular, flat ; ulcers that are very dark, almost black at base ; surrounding skin bluish-black ; oozing of blood ; burning, stinging, or biting in ulcer ; edges sharp cut and on level with surrounding skin ; pus thin, watery, bad smelling.
Very sensitive varices.
Purpura hemorrhagica with epistaxis and congestion of conjunctiva.
Articular and muscular rheumatism.
Rheumatism with great soreness of affected parts.
Incised, lacerated or contused wounds ; checks hemorrhage, removes pain and soreness and promotes healing.
Dissecting wounds.
Burns.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Ham.]
The pains are often unbearable, with great sensitiveness to touch, and fear of exciting new pain on moving.
Touch : hemorrhoids very sensitive ; swollen leg sensitive.
Had to sleep with neck free from all covering.
Pressure : swelling in right groin tender ; upper part of thigh very painful ; tenderness of right biceps <.
Slight pressure : sore pain in eyes.
Pressing eyes with fingers : > feeling of being pushed out for a few moments.
Jolting while riding in a heavy wagon over a rough road brought on uterine hemorrhage.
After a slight knock : thumb-nail becomes sore ; pus discharges.
After injury of head and face : great ecchymosis.
Blow or burn : inflammation and ulceration of conjunctiva and cornea.
Blow : right iliac region caused hæmaturia ; ovary swollen.
Bruise : causes black eye.
Caused by a fall : active uterine hemorrhage.
After a fall : threatened abortion.
   

SKIN. [46] [Ham.]
Soreness and smarting on small spots, not very sensitive to touch.
Ulcers with very thin and watery pus, bad smelling ; more an ichor than pus.
Carbuncles ; boils ; abscesses ; injuries resulting from falls.
Chilblains always bluish.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Ham.]
Hemorrhages in patients of nervo-sanguine temperament.
Boy, æt. 14, growing rapidly ; epistaxis.
Boy, after a blow ; hæmaturia.
Colored boy, after injury ; intra-ocular hemorrhage.
Irish girl, æt. 18 ; amenorrhœa.
Man, æt. 21, light complexioned, in good health ; varicocele.
Young married woman ; vaginismus.
Miss S., æt. 28 ; uterine hemorrhage.
Man, æt. 30, scrofulous ; orchitis.
Woman, æt. 30, bilious-lymphatic temperament, nursing a babe ; ovarian disease.
Woman, æt. 30, six months pregnant ; varicose veins.
Man, æt. 30, well built, strong ; hematemesis.
Colored woman, æt. 35 ; amenorrhœa.
Woman, had miscarriage during typhoid fever, subinvolution of uterus probably present ; angioleucitis.
Married woman, whose menses have always been profuse, has been suffering from dysenteric diarrhœa for day or two ; uterine hemorrhage.
Woman, plethoric habit ; epistaxis.
Married woman, mother of two children ; vaginismus.
Middle-aged man, with congested liver ; bleeding piles.
Man, æt. 40, thin ; melena.
Woman, æt. 40, mother of six children ; varices and hemorrhoids.
Woman, æt. 60, hemorrhages for over twenty years.
Woman, æt. 60, nervous temperament, was taken suddenly with a severe chill followed by fever ; phlebitis.
Old man, hemiplegic ; epistaxis.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Ham.]
Antidoted by : Arnic., Camphor., Cinchon., Pulsat. (toothache).
Complementary : to Ferrum (hemorrhages).
Compare : Arnica and Calend. (better than either in hastening absorption of intraocular hemorrhage) ; Chloral, Sul. ac., Clemat. vitalba (purpura) ; Æscul., Bovista, Collin., Eriger., Galium, Lycopus, Senec., Trillium (hemorrhages, etc.)
